_guide: Copy this folder to <your-slug>/, fill every field, delete the _-prefixed guide keys, run the validator. null ALWAYS means off/not-applicable - never invent a value.
name: Your Collection

traits.name: Background
traits._filter_options: multi-select | slider-direction (paired values like North/South - add split_suffixes) | chips

rarity._method_options: team-intended | statistical (we can compute from your trait counts) | <marketplace>-mirror

images._note: any host works - public IPFS gateway, your CDN, etc. Never a token-gated URL.

_backing_if_backed._note: see adao/ for the live example; null disables the whole broken/unbroken vocabulary

marketplaces._note: any venue: bbl | boost | atrium | other. One, several, or an empty array are all valid.

member_portfolio._note: wallet_tracking true = you consent to public holder-holdings history being stored

_branding_optional._note: applied as CSS variables when your collection context is active - the site FEELS like yours. Ships after functional wiring.
